post.headline: Do not trust a tip link on name alone
post.subtext: The public directory gives sources a place to check verified profile details before opening an anonymous message path.
post.image_alt_text: A dark-mode desktop social graphic showing the Hush Line verified directory, with profile cards for trusted recipients. The image supports guidance for sources to check the recipient before using a tip link.

social.bluesky:
Do not start with the first tip link that looks close enough.

Hush Line's public directory helps sources review verified profiles before opening an anonymous message path.

Check the recipient first: https://hushline.app.
social.linkedin:
A common mistake is treating the first tip link you find as the right one. A familiar name is not enough when the message may include sensitive details.

Hush Line's public directory gives sources a place to review verified profiles and decide whether a recipient matches the person or organization they mean to contact. You can do that in the browser without creating a sender account.

Use the directory to confirm the recipient first: https://hushline.app.
social.mastodon:
One mistake to avoid: starting with the first tip link that looks close enough.

Hush Line's public directory helps sources review verified profiles and confirm the recipient before opening an anonymous message path. No sender account is required.

Use the directory to check first: https://hushline.app.
